hints.title: Frequency Parity Check
hints.text: Count the combined frequency of each fruit across both collections. If any fruit has an odd total frequency, making the baskets identical is impossible.

hints.title: Surplus Extraction
hints.text: Determine which fruits appear in excess in each basket. Each surplus fruit must eventually be matched with a surplus fruit from the other basket.

hints.title: Indirect Swap Optimization
hints.text: Instead of directly swapping two fruits of values a and b at cost min(a, b), you can swap both with the global minimum fruit at cost 2 * min_val.

hints.title: Greedy Pair Balancing Implementation

variables: n: number of fruits in each basket
complexity.notes: Sorting surplus fruits takes O(n log n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all pairing combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for frequency counters and surplus lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that each swap can be done directly or via the minimum element.
